peak_estimate.source: Every public producer declares estimatedBytes before startManagedRun creates its run directory.

budget.maximum_managed_bytes_source: PUPPETLOOM_ARTIFACT_MAX_BYTES or the 2 GiB project default
budget.minimum_free_bytes_source: PUPPETLOOM_ARTIFACT_MIN_FREE_BYTES or the 2 GiB project default
budget.maximum_path_length_source: PUPPETLOOM_ARTIFACT_MAX_PATH_LENGTH or the 240-character Windows project default
budget.maximum_relative_path_length_source: Every public producer declares maximumRelativePathLength before startManagedRun creates lock or run infrastructure

reuse.reason: Each run is a distinct observable evidence result; repeatable PSD inputs are read from the single tracked test/fixtures source instead of being downloaded or regenerated per run.

lifecycle.preflight: Validate the complete Windows path budget, capture source/command/scope/platform identity, then measure managed bytes and filesystem free space before creating the run directory or any payload.
lifecycle.finalization: Rewrite version 2 run.json with succeeded or failed status, source-bound evidence identity, reuse decision, class byte totals, the conservative peak bound, complete file inventory, byte counts, and SHA-256 hashes.
lifecycle.interruption: A later run marks ownerless pending manifests interrupted, inventories every payload, and preserves report-only cleanup candidates.

root_source.value: psd repair/review --workdir plus the declared output PSD; repository runtime/ is ignored local state, not a source root

peak_estimate.source: estimatePsdRepairBytes combines input bytes, canvas-sized review images, layer contact sheets, output expansion, and fixed overhead before operation.json is created

budget.maximum_managed_bytes_source: PUPPETLOOM_PSD_REPAIR_MAX_BYTES or the 4 GiB project default
budget.minimum_free_bytes_source: PUPPETLOOM_PSD_REPAIR_MIN_FREE_BYTES or the 2 GiB project default
budget.maximum_path_length_source: PUPPETLOOM_PSD_REPAIR_MAX_PATH_LENGTH or the 240-character Windows project default

reuse.reason: A repair operation is bound to exact input hashes and one output path. The same operation directory resumes its own confirmed stages; it never treats another run as current evidence.

lifecycle.preflight: Validate input hashes, deterministic storage and Windows path budgets, then write and flush pending operation.json before Photoshop or review payloads.
lifecycle.finalization: Automated success stops at awaiting-visual-review. Only a hash-bound visual-review.json can produce accepted, accepted-with-repairs, or rejected.
lifecycle.interruption: An ownerless running operation becomes interrupted. The same command resumes; unconfirmed partial PSD output is moved into recovery/ and never deleted or overwritten.

root_source.value: runtimeLogPath project reports or Electron userData

peak_estimate.source: 5 MiB active segments with a 64 MiB aggregate default cap

budget.maximum_managed_bytes_source: PUPPETLOOM_RUNTIME_LOG_MAX_BYTES or the 64 MiB desktop default
budget.minimum_free_bytes_source: Incremental JSONL records remain below the active segment cap

reuse.reason: Runtime log records describe one concrete process and event sequence and cannot be reused as evidence for another run.

lifecycle.preflight: Write runtime-log-policy.json and measure aggregate owned logs before each append.
lifecycle.finalization: Rotate the active log by move when it reaches 5 MiB; never overwrite an archived segment.
lifecycle.interruption: JSONL records are append-complete per event; existing segments remain inspectable after process exit.
